definition: the huge amount held by many large casks
description: A narrow town street on a hot summer day during a water fight. On a balcony a young man and a young woman tip wooden barrels over the railing, and a huge flood of water pours from them onto a young woman in a white top and turquoise shorts standing below with her arms spread wide, laughing. She turns around under the water and then faces forward again as it splashes all over the cobbles. Colourful paper lanterns hang across the street and young people with water pistols watch.
